input.quote: This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "hire", "employ or engage", "employee" and "personnel" return no hiring or solicitation covenant anywhere in the Agreement or its Exhibits. The personnel-related provisions are purely operational: Section 13 (Shared Resources) covers access to Commerce One operations, consulting and engineering personnel and employee NDA/invention agreements, Section 14.5 confirms independent-contractor status, and Exhibit D Section 5 requires each party to assign a sales/marketing employee — none of these restrict Corio from soliciting or hiring Commerce One personnel. The integration clause confirms the four corners of the bargain contain no such covenant. This meets our preferred position (no non-solicitation restriction on Customer), so no redline is required.
